question: After the generated locale output is corrected, should yielded main sessions persist as `paused` with `pauseReason: sessions_yield`, or should this session contract align with the broader `deferred` yielded-parent vocabulary?
rationale: The patch correctly fixes the observed race, but the new persisted and gateway-visible status is an upgrade-sensitive product/API contract that overlaps another open lifecycle direction.

options.title: Adopt paused for sessions
options.body: Use `paused` for persisted interactive session rows and reserve `deferred` for cron/task outcome domains, documenting and testing that distinction.

options.title: Unify on deferred
options.body: Rename and align this PR with the broader yielded-parent lifecycle contract before either change lands.

recommendation.title: Adopt paused for sessions
recommendation.body: Use `paused` for persisted interactive session rows and reserve `deferred` for cron/task outcome domains, documenting and testing that distinction.
